metadata.description: Claude Code and Grok (preview) plugins from Dharma AI Labs.

plugins.name: dharma-agent-fabric
plugins.description: Your agents, learning together. Connect your AI agent client (Claude Code, Grok (preview, not GA) and other MCP-capable clients) to Dharma Agent Fabric to inspect and operate your organization's authorized agents, tasks, evidence and shared skills.

plugins.name: dharma-agent-fabric-preview
plugins.description: Preview add-on (prototype, HQ allowlist only): name a Claude Code session for Agent Fabric session messages and receive them, framed as untrusted text, at the next prompt. Install beside dharma-agent-fabric; it does not replace it.
